# curves-shapes.types: SphericalSpiral3D

**Tier:** `geometry`. **File:** [curves-shapes.types](../curves-shapes.types.md). **Source:** [stdlib/geometry/curves-shapes.types.plato, line 469](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/curves-shapes.types.plato#L469).

Copied from source, comments included. A comment records intent. The body is the algorithm. Neither is a proof that the result is correct. Names resolve in the whole compilation.

This slice: SphericalSpiral3D, TorusKnot, TrefoilKnot, FigureEightKnot, VivianiCurve.

```plato

// A loxodrome: a spiral on a sphere of radius Radius crossing every meridian
// at a constant angle, running pole to pole along the frame's Z axis and
// completing TurnCount revolutions
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhumb_line).
type SphericalSpiral3D
    implements ICurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Radius: Number;
    TurnCount: Number;
}

//==
// # Knots and classical space curves

// The (p,q) torus knot on the torus with the given major and minor radii about
// the frame's Z axis. AxisWindings is p (laps around the main axis) and
// TubeWindings is q (laps through the hole); coprime windings give a true knot
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_knot).
type TorusKnot
    implements IClosedCurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    AxisWindings: Integer;
    TubeWindings: Integer;
    MajorRadius: Number;
    MinorRadius: Number;
}

// The trefoil knot, the simplest nontrivial knot (the (2,3) torus knot), in
// its symmetric canonical form scaled by Scale
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trefoil_knot).
type TrefoilKnot
    implements IClosedCurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Scale: Number;
}

// The figure-eight knot (the unique four-crossing knot) in its canonical
// parametric form scaled by Scale
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure-eight_knot_(mathematics)).
type FigureEightKnot
    implements IClosedCurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Scale: Number;
}

// Viviani's curve: the figure-eight intersection of the sphere of radius
// Radius centered at the frame origin with the cylinder of radius Radius / 2
// tangent to the frame's Z axis
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viviani%27s_curve).
type VivianiCurve
    implements IClosedCurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Radius: Number;
}
```
